result.question: Quais municípios com mais de 500 internações aparecem simultaneamente no top-20 de volume e no top-20 de taxa de mortalidade nos estados MA e RS?
result.gold_sql:
WITH top_volume AS (
    SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS nome
    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
    WHERE mu."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS')
    GROUP BY mu."NO_MUNICIPIO"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 500
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 20
), top_mortalidade AS (
    SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS nome
    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
    WHERE mu."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS')
    GROUP BY mu."NO_MUNICIPIO"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 500
    ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 20
)
SELECT tv.nome
FROM top_volume tv
WHERE tv.nome IN (SELECT nome FROM top_mortalidade)
ORDER BY tv.nome;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE mu."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ), ranked_internacoes AS ( SELECT municipio, total_internacoes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC) AS rank_volume FROM internacoes_por_municipio ), taxa_mortalidade AS ( SELECT municipio, ROUND(SUM(total_mortes) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_internacoes), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes_por_municipio GROUP BY municipio ) SELECT r."municipio" FROM ranked_internacoes r JOIN taxa_mortalidade t ON r."municipio" = t."municipio" WHERE r.rank_volume <= 20 AND t.taxa_mortalidade IS NOT NULL AND t.taxa_mortalidade > 0 ORDER BY r.total_internacoes DESC;
